svg.aria-label: Parallax: codex and claude look at one change from two positions; where their lines cross is the evidence.
svg.title: Parallax: codex and claude look at one change from two positions; where their lines cross is the evidence.

g.text: One model builds. The other checks, blind.
Two different models on every change. Their agreement is the evidence.
Their disagreement is the only thing that reaches you.
